_comment: Copy to the app's userData directory as identities.json, or point at it
with PIGEON_IDENTITIES for a test run. Never commit the real one — it
No file at all means every inbox goes out direct, as before.
Keep timezone and locale consistent with where the exit actually is: a
London address reporting America/New_York is a bigger tell than no proxy.
